survey: A stylized saguaro cactus seen from the front at a slight angle. The main trunk is a ribbed vertical column with a rounded top. Its base sinks into the sand, with a slight hollow and a contact shadow where it meets the ground. Two arms branch off the trunk. The left arm comes out lower and slightly behind the trunk, curves into an elbow and rises vertically. The right arm comes out higher, in front of the trunk's right side, and also rises vertically. Both arms have rounded ribbed tips. Small cone-shaped spine nubs are spread along the ribs of the trunk and both arms. A single pink flower with a yellow center sits on a small green collar at the crown of the trunk, which is where saguaros really flower. Rocks rest on the sand around the base.
